fusions.name: Hopping Slug
fusions.desc: Fires a slug that deals 7 damage, then hops to 3 more enemies within 4 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the damage. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Landing Salvo
fusions.desc: You leap up to 6 tiles to the target and fire all around you as you land, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Impossible Angle
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you land.

fusions.name: Itch to Fire
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (29% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
